page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal instance equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. Processing is handled by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz. System memory totals 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a uniform allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The bare metal architecture provides direct access to physical CPU and memory resources without hypervisor virtualization layers.

This instance includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for file systems and state retention. To accommodate remote disk input-output and distributed network traffic, the system provides a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no GPUs or specialized hardware accelerators.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio provides dense resource allocation for enterprise multithreading. The bare metal implementation eliminates virtualization jitter and hypervisor contention. Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is configured for large enterprise application deployments, relational databases, container orchestration nodes, and high-concurrency general-purpose tasks.
